title: TOTVW: Wolf Additions
description: Adds on-attack enchantment effects for wolves, new mechanics, and more
body:
# Tales of the Verdant Wind
### A Wolf Additions Mod

This mod introduces several custom enchantments to help enhance your wolf companion's on-attack combat abilities. Depending on the enchantments available in your companion's armor, it can trigger different effects and even powerful ones depending on the circumstances.

![A photo showcasing the Verixium Armor Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/215625256bcf0fd252c5a76f0aa6345f38f37dea.webp)
*Shader used: Solas Shader*

---

## ⚔️ Core Enchantment Additions

### Benediction of the Verdant Mountains
As the name suggests, this enchantment provides both buff and defense.

When holding a tool or weapon with a **[VW]** mark, hold **CTRL + Right Click** to activate the buff. The buff provided depends on what tool you are holding — duration and amplifier are also increased when within the Verdant Biomes!

![A photo showing the VW Active mark when the Benediction of the Verdant Mountains enchantment is active.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e22fafd6b791e12bfe462273463807999bb799f8.png)

If your wolf companion has the enchantment, when your health drops below 30%, it will grant **Blessing of the Verdant Wind** (30 sec) and **temporary immunity** for 10 seconds. This buff also applies to your companion when you have the enchantment and their health drops below said threshold. The cooldown duration depends on your current game difficulty.

---

### Wolf Armor Enhancement Kit
The vanilla wolf armor doesn't offer much beyond damage absorption. This enchantment fixes that by adjusting your companion's base attributes — max health, movement speed (land and water), knockback resistance, and more.

---

### Wolf ATK Effect: Might
When your companion attacks, it grants itself **Absorption** and the custom **Amplified Might** effect for a short period, scalable by enchantment level.

At level **3 or higher**:
- Forcibly removes the **Strength** effect from the target
- Deals an additional instance of damage when the target is below **50% health** — damage scales based on distance. The cooldown duration depends on your current game difficulty.

> There are **7 more Wolf ATK Effects** waiting to be discovered!

---

## 🌿 Core World Additions

### New Biomes
**Verdant Mountains**: A jagged peaks that is home to both the Sniffer and Wolves.

**Verdant Forest**: A dense, ancient woodland shrouded in a teal-green atmospheric haze that is more packed with wolf.

> Both biomes are home to Verixium ore, verdant flora, and are where the Benediction of the Verdant Mountains enchantment and wolf companion mechanics reach their full potential.

---

### New Blocks
- Verdant Spruce Wood Set
- Verixium Fluid
- Verixium Chunk Ores

---

### New Items

#### A. Verixium Raw Materials
Obtaining the Verixium Ingot requires a bit of work. The full processing chain is:

> **Ore → Chunk → Condensed → Shard → Powder → Ingot**

1. Mine **Verixium Chunk Ore** (exclusive to Verdant Biomes) to get chunks
2. Combine **4 chunks** in a 2×2 grid to get **Condensed Verixium**
3. Put **Condensed Verixium** in a stonecutter to get a **Verixium Shard**
4. Blast the shard in a **Blast Furnace** for **Verixium Powder** + substantial XP
5. Place a **Diamond** in the center of a 3×3 grid surrounded by **Verixium Powder** to get the **Verixium Ingot**

---

#### B. Verixium Armor Set
- **Player armor** — craft directly with Verixium Ingots, same pattern as diamond armor
- **Wolf Armor** — obtain the vanilla Wolf Armor and a **Verixium Armor Upgrade Template**, then use a Smithing Table
- **Horse Armor** — same process as the wolf armor, but start with **Diamond Horse Armor** instead

![Verixium Armor Upgrade Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1040429ed3aec56cbec6010c32a7c2aa509dfc86.png)

---

#### C. Verixium Tools & Weapons
Craft directly with Verixium Ingots using the same patterns as diamond tools and weapons.

---

### New Mob Effects

| Effect | Description |
|---|---|
| **Blessing of the Verdant Wind** | +20% max health, −20% burn time, +15% attack damage, heals every 3 sec |
| **Amplified Might** | Boosts armor toughness, knockback resistance, max absorption, and more |
| **Bloodlust** | Massive attack buff at the cost of constant self-damage and reduced armor protection |
| **Paralyze** | Drastically reduces all combat and movement attributes |

---

### Additional
Tooltips for item descriptions and lore have been added (with more to come).

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
> **Settings can be modified manually or through [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) via the `tales-of-the-verdant-wind.json` file in your config folder.**

---

## 📦 Dependencies
> **This mod requires [TerraBlender](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrablender) and [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) to work.**
